text:
Situation: Hydrocodone bitartrate and acetaminophen 10 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 263 tablets (16.7 days), Corvale General holds 558 tablets (28.8 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 59 tablets (12.4 days). Lakeside's supply is below our 14-day internal threshold.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include this product as of 2026-10-21. Proficient Rx LP, a repackager linked to this product, received VAI classifications in 2015 and 2022.

Our position: Overall system inventory is adequate, but Lakeside faces a near-term gap. All ranked purchasing options are from manufacturers not on FDA's shortage list today; however, none of their labels name a plant we can verify for supply assurance.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place an expedited order for Lakeside from the top-ranked option (Alvogen Inc.) pending buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify secondary sources (Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC, Aurolife Pharma LLC, AvPAK) pending buyer approval.
3. Buyer to request plant-level supply confirmation from each manufacturer before committing volume pending buyer approval.
4. Pharmacy director to approve inter-site transfer from General to Lakeside to cover the immediate gap pending pharmacy director approval.
5. Buyer to monitor FDA's shortage list weekly and report any status change to the committee pending buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
